༄༅/ /yang zlog me'i spu gri'i bsnyen sgrub las sbyor rnams kyi tshod 'dzin nang rtags drod

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// yang zlog me'i spu gri'i bsnyen sgrub las sbyor rnams kyi tshod 'dzin nang rtags drod

tshad rgyud las byung ba bzhugs so// bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ 'dir dbang thob cing dam tshig sdom pa la gnas pa'i sngags pas/ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed bsnyen cing sgrub pa'i tshe na nang rtags 'byung tshul rnams bkol te bri ba ni/ bsnyen pa dang*/ sgrub pa dang*/ las sbyor gsum las/ dang po zla gsang gzhi bsnyen la rtags thon pa zhig shin tu gal che bas/ gzhi bsnyen gyi bsnyen rtags ni/ gshin rje'i gshed gsang ba dgu bcu pa'i le'u gsum pa las/ rtsa sngags rgyun du bzlas byas pas// mchod rten lus skyes khong na yod// bang rim la 'dzegs sku gzugs 'byung*// chu la mi nub bon po 'byung*// mtshan ma gtan la dbab pa yin// dus ni lo zla yun du bsring*// grangs ni bye ba chig 'bum rdzogs/ /zhes dang*/ rgyud de'i srog la drangs pa'i le'u las/ srog snying nyi ma shar ltas 'byung*// dge bshes bon po mi nag 'byung*| |phyogs bcu gshin rje'i zhing khams nas// bya rgod gzan la bcum bzhin 'byung*// zhes dang*/ yang de nyid kyi sngags kyi tshad ma'i le'u las| rtsa ba rgyan gyi drag sngags la// mi lus phra men mgo can rab// mchod rten sgra can byung na 'bring*// me 'bar chu la me bying tha// zhes rab 'bring tha ma gsum du gsungs shing*/ gshin rje'i gshed nag po sngags rgyud kyi le'u brgyad pa las/ bde gshegs gzugs brnyan mkha' la nyi zla shar// mgon gnyer bshes sogs rmi na rtags| |zhes sogs gsungs so// nye bar bsnyen pa'i rtags ni/ gsang ba dgu bcu pa'i rgyud kyi le'u drug pa las/ rtags ni yang dag mngon du ston// mgo la nyi shar lho sgo 'byed| |dge bshes mon pa rtags can 'byung*// zhes so// gshin rje dmar nag 'bar ba'i dme rgyud kyi le'u gsum pa las/ sngags nyid lha yi skur gyur pa/ snang ba'i dus na skur gsal ba'i// stong pa'i dus na rdzogs pa nyid// sgyu lus lha yi sku ru 'pho// ngag ni grag stong sngags su 'pho// sems nyid gsal stong chen por 'pho// sgrib pa gsum las rim par grol| |nam mkha' bzhin du mnyam rdzogs che// 'khor lo thams cad rdzogs par 'dod// dka' thub chen po byed pa na// bsad pa'i las kyi sngags kyang gdangs/

sku gzugs bzhad dam 'gul ba'am// lung ston sgra'am gzugs brnyan nam// rmi lam rnams ni mang du 'byung*// brtan par rig nas dngos grub 'byung*// zhes dang*/ gshin rje dmar nag 'bar ba'i dme rgyud kyi le'u nyer brgyad pa las/ snying po yi ge bcu bdun bzlas// de tshe mtshan rtags mang po 'byung*// sku gzugs bzhad dang 'gul ba'am// lung ston sgra'am gzugs brnyan nam// rmi lam rtags rnams mang po 'byung*// de nas bstod cing phrin las brtsam// bsnyen pa'i mngon rtags ma byung na// sa ma ya la sel yod pas// lus ngag 'bad pas bshags pa bya// des kyang mngon du ma gyur na// las 'phro med dam bsod nams zhan// de yi bya ba ma gtogs pa// kun gyi byas na rang la gnod// ces dang*/ gshin rje nag po sngags rgyud kyi le'u lnga pa las/ mthong dang thos dang rmi lam gsum// bsnyen pa'i rtags su shes par bya// zhes gsungs pas/ lha'i gzugs mthong na rab dang*/ sngags kyi sgra'i don lung ston pa'i sgra thos pa 'bring dang*/ de gnyis rmi lam du byung ba ni bsnyen rtags tha mar bshad cing*/ 'jam dpal khro bo gsang ba'i rgyud le'u lnga pa las/ de tshe mtshan ma'i yul la 'bad// 'od phung 'khyil dang lung ston sgra// rmi lam rtags rnams mang du 'byung*// mtshan ma mang po byung ba dang*// dngos grub blang ba'i cho ga bya// rtags rnams mngon du ma byung na// dam tshig bshags la bsnyen pa spog /dka' thub ldan pa'i brtul zhugs spyod// mi smra mi spur mi 'khyam par// lho yi phyogs su kha bltas te// ku sha'i stan la 'dug nas ni// ri mo dag la sems blta zhing*// bzlas pa'i yi ge'i rim pa bya// bying nas shes pa rmugs gyur na// 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rab bskul bya// rgod cing g.yeng bar gyur pa na// mgo ni rma bya bzhin bkug la// mtshan ma lha yi sku la brtag /ji srid du ni chos skyong bar// rtse gcig sems kyis blta bar bya// be shing seng ldeng thogs nas ni// zhing lpags bgo zhing dom lpags 'ding*// bgrod dka'i dur khrod gnas su 'grim// myur ba ma yin bul ba min// de bzhin 'dres pa'i yi ge min// shin tu gsal zhing dag par smra// zhes gsungs pa ltar/

bsgrims te rtse gcig bzla dgos so// sgrub pa chen po'i dus su ni rtags byung ma byung ci yin yang sngags 'bum phrag gcig po gnyid sogs spangs nas thems ma thag dngos grub kyi rdzas la longs spyod do// 'chi bdag bdud sgrub kyi tshe rtags ni/ 'jam dpal khro bo gsang ba'i rgyud kyi le'u lnga pa las/ bshan pa las mkhan byung ba'i tshe// dmigs pa dgu pa'i las bya ste// sngags dang ting 'dzin pho nya dgug /ces dang*/ gshin rje nag po sngags kyi rgyud kyi le'u bdun pa las/ go gyon mtshon thogs dmag sna 'dren pa dang*// dgra yi bla bkug thugs rjes bsgral rmis na// phrin las drag po'i las la 'jug par bya// zhes sogs gsungs pas/ mdor na bsnyen pa dang*/ nye bar bsnyen pa/ sgrub pa chen po rnams tshad du thems shing drod rtags thob pa/ 'chi bdag bdud sgrub kyi tshe 'chi bdag gshin rje sogs sde brgyad 'grub cing bran du 'khol ba'i rtags thob nas srung zlog bsad mnan sogs las sbyor la 'jug par bya yi/ gang rung bsnyen sgrub drod rtags ma thob par las sbyor byed pa mi phung rang brlag gi rgyu yin par gsungs so// bsnyen sgrub thems nas las sbyor gyis tshe srung ba dang*/ zlog pa dang*/ bsad pa gsum rtags dang ldan par 'grub pa zhig gal che zhing*/ de'ang srung ba'i tshe mkhar du zhugs pa la sogs pa dang*/ zlog pa'i tshe shwa sbud thog ser zlog pa sogs dang*/ bsad pa'i tshe thog mar dgra bo'i bla khug pa zhig gal che ste/ bla dwags brgyad dam bcu gnyis sogs khug pa'i mtshan ma mthong ba/ de'ang srung ma dang*/ bdag dang*/ dgra bo'i bla ma nor ba gal che zhing*/ bla khug nas lha dang phral ba'i rtags dang*/ de nas bsad pa'i rtags glo snying ster ba sogs drod tshad nang rtags nges nges lan 'ga' yar gyis gtan la phab nas/ mtha' rgyan mnan sreg 'phang gsum sogs bgyis nas kyang nang rtags las sbyor gyi sgrub pa'i tshe nang rtags ma byung na skabs su gang bab kyi sngags bsdebs rnams gnad ma 'chug par gsang sngags snying gzer nas bshad pa ltar bya'o// ldan pas dus btab pas chog pa zhig gal che ba ni/

yang zlog me'i spu gri'i gzhung dang zhal gdams rnams su mdor bsdus 'gag don dril nas yod pa rnams dang*/ gzhan yang rdo rje gtsug lag gi rgyud lcags sdig gi drod tshad gser thur rnam gsum dang*/ rdzogs 'phrang srog gsum/ gter khyim/ bla khyim/ srog khyim sogs dang*/ rje 'bangs grogs gsum gyi mthu'i zhus lan skor dang nor ra re'i brtag pa sogs mngon spyod spyi gzhung rnams nas 'byung ba ltar dpyad cing*/ lar ni phrin las bzhi gang sgrub kyang nang rtags drod tshad la mkhas pa zhig shin tu gal che'o// de dag thams cad la spyi sdom du gal che ba ni/ gshin rje gsang ba dgu bcu pa'i rgyud las/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag gi tshad ma'i rim pa 'di gsungs so// mchod rten nyi shar tshur me 'gyur// mtshon cha bon po slob dpon dang*// pha ma mon nag smra ba dang*| |byis sba byung ba las sbyor g.yon// nyi ma bzhi skor nub mo dril// rtags ni 'od dang go khrab dang*// mtshon cha dang ni tsau ra thob// khug nas bsad pa'i las la 'byung*// lce 'og tsha dang 'brum pas khengs// ma nor tshangs las 'grub rtags yin// dam tshig nyams bsal myur du 'grub// snying za seng seng por byed na// mi 'grub ma tshang tshad ma yin// bying na sgrib yod bshags pa bya// bdag gi lus sbrid sha 'dar na// thugs kyi bskangs bas dgra rnams sgrol// gshin rje'i gshed gsang ba dgu bcu pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las/ bdag gi dam tshig tshad ma'i le'u ste nyi shu gcig pa'o// de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bsgrub bya'i tshad ma 'di gsungs so// g.yag dang ra dang ba glang nye// rta dang bong bu mi 'grub rtags// ting 'dzin mi gsal khro 'dod na// rgyab brten yod pas dbye bsal bya// lug bsad rang gi 'khor g.yog che// dgra rnams dngos su byung na rab// ting 'dzin gsal zhing dngos bsad na| |zhag bdun zla bdun bar gyis 'chi// khung chung khug rnams chen por btang*// dug gsum byung na ya tsa ra// bcu bdun mthar sbyar mkhas pas bskor// lus zad la sogs zad pa brgyad| |rigs gsum mgon pos brlag par 'gyur// gshin rje'i gshed gsang ba dgu bcu pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las// bsgrub bya dgra'i tshad ma'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa dgu pa'o// de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis mtshan ma brtag pa'i tshad ma 'di gsungs so// rtags la rnam pa gnyis su shes// dngos su snang ba mtshan mar ro// dngos su snang ba phyi nang gnyis// mtshan mar snang ba rnam pa bzhi// rab 'bring tha ma mi 'gyur rtags// pho sgrub mo dang mo sgrub pho// zhub can bande bud med dang*// btsun pa zhang blon pha khu dang*// bon po mang po 'byung bar 'gyur| |rtags de rnam pa gnyis su 'gyur// las rnams tshud dang ma tshud pa'o// de rnams sbrags nas dmag dpon byed// dmag 'dren btsas brnga so so bshig

/rka gcod kong len chu bskyil dang*// me sbar shing gcod brag gshig dang*// rngon byed khyi 'gyed bshan pa byed// ro la sbar sha byed pa dang*// bso dang ha dang thod le'i sgra// kun tu sgrog cing dgyes tshul ston// las la tshud pa'i rtags su brtan// de las ldog pa ma tshud pa'o// mo sgrub pho byung myur du 'jug /pho sgrub mo byung las rnams 'gyang*// sdig pa sbyang dang bskang gsol bya// lag cha ma tshang sngags skyon yin// mtshon cha'i sngags la rab tu 'jug /bande mang byung byi bo 'gros// bcu bdun pa la 'jug par bya// btsun pa mang po 'bru ded bdun// zhub can mang byung g.yas skor bsad// zhang blon pha khu drag sngags bdun// bud med na chung dam tshig sngags// skya shar phyin mthong sngon 'gro ltem// rtags mtshan brgyad cus gtan la phab// bzlas thabs gsang sngags rtags dang sbyar// gshin rje'i gshed gsang ba dgu bcu pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las/ mtshan ma rtags kyi tshad ma'i le'u sum cu pa'o// zhes dang*/ gshin rje dmar nag 'bar ba'i dme rgyud las// bsnyen sgrub las la sbyar ba yi// rbod gtong dme stobs 'gran dus su// rtags rnams 'khrugs par ston pa dang*// rang rang rtags su 'byung 'gyur te// rbod gtong bzlog pas kho rang brlag /me 'bar ba dang 'od shar dang*// nyi zla shar dang nam langs dang*// bande mon dang rgya gar dang*// rab byung dang ni mon mo dang*// rdo rje slob dpon byung ba na// ye shes lha tshogs nye ba yin// mkha' la 'phur nas rtsang phur 'debs// mtshon cha rdung dang 'debs pa dang*// lus shugs che la sems kyang yol// des ni rab tu 'grub pa yin// mda' dang mde'u char pa byung*// de dag kho yi rbod gtong yin// rtags ni gang dang gang byung yang*// phar la gsod dang 'dzing ba bzang*| |tshur la gnod par byed pa na// de tshe drag sngags bzla zhing gcun// mdze bo zhub can mdo dang btsun// gshin rje'i rtags su shes par bya// de rjes nyams dga' sems gsal na| |drag po'i sngags kyang bzla mi dgos// nyams 'jigs ngu khro snying mi dga'// lus ni gti mug chen por gyur// de tshe lha yi skur gsal ba'i// drag sngags phyogs su 'phang bas 'grub| |mun sros pa dang rgya mtsho 'khyil// g.yag dang ra yis khengs pa dang*// bud med gtsar bu mthong ba dang*// btsun pa btsad po ā tsa ra// rta pa mang po byung ba dang*// brag dmar 'dzegs dang brag nag dang*// sbrul dang sbal pa nya lcong dang*// ba glang mang po byung ba dang*// rkang mang mang po byung ba dang*// lha khang chos 'khor ston pa dang*// mi ring skya bo byung ba dang*// bon po ral pa can yang 'byung*// bande mang po 'byung ba dang*// ra lug byung dang byis pa byung*// khyi phag mu sprang byung ba dang*// rje dpon dang ni rig 'dzin dang*// 'bri gnag mang po byung ba dang*/

khra spyang mang po byung ba dang*// mon pa sbrul zhags khyer ba byung*// gang byung rtags byung drag sngags gnad// yungs kar la sogs bzlas la gtor// de yis rang gshed 'bebs par byed// dregs pa de dag 'khor bcas kyi// ded dpon sdong zla grogs dang ni// pho nya las mkhan phra men dang*// bar chad byed pa'i log 'dren rnams// srog gi yi ge'i gnad dag ni// shes pas gdug pa yang dag zhi// shin tu 'khrug na 'khor lo bskor// rtags rnams 'khrugs na spyi srog bcad// rang gshed gang mos gang 'gro blta// srung zlog bsad mnan gyi sgrub pa'i skabs nang rtags rmi lam dang bstun pa'i rang gshed dang dkrug sbyor sogs skabs su gang bab gnad dang bstun nas byed pa gal che'o// srung dang zlog dang bsad dang mnan| |me la sreg dang dam bdar la// dregs pa zhi dang dngos grub 'thob// ces gsungs so// 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed dmar nag 'bar ba'i dme rgyud las/ rdo rje nang 'gras rtags kyi le'u ste zhe brgyad pa'o// zhes gsungs pa rnams nyams su bstar nas sgrub pa'i dus nang rtags drod tshad rmi lam gyis 'dzin dgos pas gtso cher srung zlog bsad mnan gyi sngags 'bad cing*/ kha bsgyur nang rtags dang bstun pa'i sngags kyi sham 'dogs ni sdebs rgyud rnams dang*/ lcags sdig sogs gzhung chen rnams kyis kha bskangs pa thun 'og rnams su bzla'am| yang na sgrub po mang na nang rtags dang bstun pa'i sngags rnams dang*/ bla 'gugs sngags sogs sham 'dogs rnams rang gis bzla/ srung zlog bsad mnan sogs sgrub gzhung gi sngags rnams ni sgrub grogs rnams kyis nyin mtshan khor yug tu bzla'o// gzhan yang gnad rnams zhal shes so// 'di ltar tshod 'dzin drod tshad rnams kyang shin tu gal che ba'i phyir 'khrul rmongs rnams kyi ngag sgros la ma ltos par rang nyid 'jam dpal gshin rje'i rgyud rnams nas rang nyid kyis bsdus pa ste/

'di'ang gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnal 'byor pa chos kyi grags pas| chu sprel cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes bcu bdun la mtshams mal gyi khongs nas/ pho brang bkra shis tshugs kyi re'u mig padma 'od du bris pa ste dge bar gyur cig /yang zla gsang 'jam dpal thugs kyi rtsa rgyud nyams su blang ba'i le'u bco lnga pa las/ gang dang ldan par 'brel phrin las bzhi gang sgrub kyang*/ ba'i rtags// shes pas rang gi sems/ rtags kyi tshad bzung bya// rim bsnyen sgrub las sbyor go rim ma log pa/ pa nges pa'i tshad ma dang*// cho ga las las gang sgrub kyi rim pa ma nor ba/ kyi tshad ma dang*/ drag po sngags srung zlog bsad mnan 'bod rbad bsad pa sogs gang yin gyi sngags ma nor ba/ kyi tshad ma dang*// rnal 'byor brtan las gang sgrub kyi dmigs pa gsal la ma nor ba/ pa'i tshad ma dang*// gzas pa khug nang rtags gang yin lan gsum las mi nyung bar byung ba/ pa'i tshad ma dang*// sbyor ba nang rtags dang bstun pa'i las sbyor bzhi gang yin yang ma nor ba/ nges pa'i tshad ma'o// zhes tshad ma drug gis gtan la 'bebs dgos gsungs 'dug go// yang 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud kyi le'u bcu drug par/ bzlas pa'i sngags ni thams cad pa// rmi lam dge dang mi dge dang*// sems can mchog dang tha ma yin// spyod pa yon tan rgya cher ldan| |zhes bzlas pa'i drod tshad nang rtags rmi lam la brtag par gsungs la/ yang rgyud de nyid kyi le'u nyer drug par/ gang gi dus dang mtshan ma las// dus min 'grub par 'dod pa ni| |mdor na brgya byin yin na yang*/ /de yis sngags rnams mi 'grub bo/ /zhes sgrub pa la grangs dus rtags gsum ga'i bsnyen pa 'bad nas/ nang rtags kyi tshad nges par gtan la 'bebs pa gal che'o/ /'di dges nyes mun smag rum mthar byed cing*/ /buddha'i bstan dar de 'dzin zhabs brtan cing*/
/der 'tshe'i dgra zhi dharma'i dga' ston gyis/ /saṃ gha'i 'dus rgyas 'gro kun bder 'god shog| //sarba maṅga laṃ//
